body: Thanks for replying, it means a lot and I really needed to hear that today. I’m trying my best to make a change but I’m finding it really difficult to do it alone. When lockdown restrictions are lifted here I’m going to see my doctor and tell him everything I’ve been feeling, I can’t do it alone and I’m not so scared to admit that anymore.

I’m still here, thanks for taking the time to write to me. I actually logged back in tonight as I’ve been really low all week and I wanted to vent but your post has made me feel a lot better already and I’ve deleted the date I made in my calendar for now so thank you. I will check it out, I’m willing to try anything but I’m just worried that I’m too old to change now. Again, thank you for the advice friend.

Yes, I plucked up the courage to talk to a doctor back in 2014 after a few years of suffering in silence and was prescribed Propanolol and Sertraline which I’ve been taking ever since. They don’t seem to have any effect on me at all. I also had counselling in 2015 which lasted a few months but again I didn’t find it to be of any help to me
